title: 在雪地里呼救
text:
【故事复现】在雪地里呼救
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听Freya慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: How did the woman get help?
问题：这位女士是怎么寻求帮助的？
词汇准备
• thick 厚的
• signal 信号
• stamp 跺，踩
• helicopter 直升飞机
• scene 现场
• survivor 幸存者
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago, it crashed in the
mountains and its pilot was killed.
不久前，一架轻型客机偏离了航线，在山区坠毁，飞行员丧生。
The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
机上仅有的乘客，一位年轻的妇女和她的两个女婴却平安无事。
It was the middle of winter. Snow lay thick on the ground. The woman knew that the
nearest village was miles away.
此时正值隆冬季节，地面上积着厚厚的雪。这位妇女知道，即使最近的村庄也
有数英里远。
When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it,
covering them with all the clothes she could find.
天黑下来的时候，她把提箱当作小床，把两个孩子放了进去，又把所有能找到
的衣服都盖在了孩子们身上。
During the night, it got terribly cold. The woman kept as near as she could to the
children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
夜里，天冷得厉害。这位妇女尽可能地靠近孩子，甚至自己也想钻进箱子里
去，只是箱子太小了。
Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could
send a signal.
第二天一大早，她听到头顶上有飞机飞过，但不知道怎样才能发个信号。
Then she had an idea. She stamped out the letters ‘SOS’ in the snow.
后来她有了一个主意。她在雪地上踩出了“SOS” 这3个字母。
Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
幸运得很，一位飞行员看到这个信号，用无线电给最近的城镇发了报。
It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the
plane crash.
不久，一架直升飞机抵达飞机失事现场，来搭救这几个幸存者。
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS
but 1 Plane crashed—mountains
2 Only passengers—woman,
baby daughters not hurt.
and 3mid-winter, extremely cold
so 4 Put children in a case.
5Covered them—clothes
6 Kept close all night.
and 7 Planes—next morning.
when 8 Stamped ‘SOS’—snow.
This 9 Seen by a pilot.
who 10 Message sent.
and 11 Rescued—helicopter
Answer: A plane crashed in the mountains, but the only passengers, a young
woman and her two baby daughters, were not hurt. It was midwinter and
extremely cold, so the woman put the children in a case, covered them with
clothes and kept close to them all night. When she heard planes early next
morning, she stamped out SOS in the snow. This was seen by a pilot, who sent
a radio message, and they were soon rescued by a helicopter.
•Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. The plane crashed because ________.
(a)it was a light passenger plane
(b)the pilot was killed
(c)it wasn't flying in the right direction
(d) it was the middle of winter
2. The next morning a pilot flying overhead ___________.
(a) must have seen the letters 'SOS' in the snow
(b) must have seen the woman
(c)must have seen the wrecked plane
(d) must have seen the children
3. She was a young woman. The woman was __________.
(a)a youth
(b)young
(c) young
(d) youth
4. Did the snow _______ thick on the ground?
(a)lay
(b)laid
(c)lain
(d) lie
5. It was too small. It wasn't __________.
(a)enough big
(b)big enough
(c) fairly big
(d) rather big
6. She heard planes ________ overhead.
(a)pass
(b) to pass
(c) to passing
(d) in passing
7. It was not long before helicopter arrived. It arrived _________.
(a)after
(b)soon afterwards
(c) behind
(d) much later
8. It was a light plane. It wasn't _________.
(a)dark
(b)heavy
(c)black
(d)deep
9. It got terribly cold. The cold was _________.
(a)frightening
(b)horrifying
(c)shocking
(d)frightful
10. She wondered how she could send a signal. She wanted to send _________.
(a)a letter
(b)a sign
(c)a signature
(d)a message
11. She probably stamped out the letters 'SOS' with her __________.
(a)hands
(b) head
(c)feet
(d)knees
12. The survivors were ________.
(a)live
(b)lively
(c)alive
(d)in life
Key: 1c 2a 3b 4d 5b 6a 7b 8b 9d 10d 11c 12c
第五十九单元【语法点拨】
英语中的否定
英语中表示否定的形式很多，应正确理解各种形式否定的意义及其否定重点所
在,这对于正确理解原文和翻译都很重要。否定包括完全否定、部分否定、否定
之否定以及否定转移。
▶ 完全否定
表示完全否定的词有：no, not, never, nothing, none, nobody, nowhere, neither...nor,
without,等等。
• He’s no fool.他是精明能干的。
• She’s clever, but her elder brother is not as clever.
她很聪明，但她哥哥没有她聪明。
• The patient’s condition is never the better.患者的病情根本没有好转。
• He claimed that he had nothing to do with the case.
他声称他与此案毫无关系。
• Never offer to teach fish to swim.
[谚]不要班门弄斧。
• None of soldiers survived the war.
没有人在战争中成为幸存者。
• The new book you need is nowhere to be found.
你要的那本新书什么地方都没有找到。
• He makes nothing of his illness.他根本不把病放在心上。
• Nothing is impossible to a willing heart.
[谚]有志者，事竟成(世上无难事，只怕有心人)。
▶ 部分否定
all, both, every, often, always, much, many等与not连用时，常常表示部分否
定。
• All that glitters is not gold.发光的并非都是金子。
• All are not saints that go to church.
[谚]上教堂去的未必都是虔诚慈善的人。
• Every color is not reflected back.并非每种颜色的光都会反射回来。
• Both of the substances do not dissolve in water.
这两种物质并非都溶于水中。
• Not every student in this classroom is from China.
在这个教室里并非每个学生都来自中国。
▶ 否定之否定
▪否定之否定，又称为双重否定，即强意否定。
• There is no one in our class but wishes(= who does not wish) to learn English
well.
我们班上没有一个同学不想学好英语。(我们班上的同学都想学好英
语。)
• There is no steel not containing carbon.没有不含碳的钢。(钢都含有碳。)
• It is impossible for heat to be converted into a certain energy without
something lost.
热能转换成某种能量而不损耗是不可能的。(热能转换成某种能一定有
损耗。)
• It is not an unwelcome piece of news.这是一条很受欢迎的消息。
▶ 否定转移
▪有 些 动 词， 如 think, suppose, believe, expect, hope, fear, fancy, trust, seem,
appear, imagine, assume, guess, reckon, afraid等的否定式，若带宾语从句，
否定的重点往往在从句之中，这就叫做否定转移。
• I don’t think you’ve met each other before. Let me introduce you.
我想你们以前没有见过面吧，让我给你们介绍一下。
• She did not believe that such things mattered much.
她认为这类事情不怎么重要。
• Can you come next week? 你下星期能来吗?
—I’m afraid not. (=I’m afraid that I cannot come.)恐怕不能来。
